memberDepartmentBlock.title: Member & Department
memberDepartmentBlock.description: A member directory and expandable department workspace with search, account-status filters, and responsive organization details.
memberDepartmentBlock.integrationBody: Pass members and departments to replace the included member directory and organization tree, and pass departmentDirectory for the expandable department table and detail panel. Department totals are derived from members: child departments count their direct non-departed members, and parent departments recursively include every descendant. The block owns transient search, status filters, department scoping, expansion, pagination, and mobile drawers. Use onCreateMember, onCreateDepartment, onMemberOpen, onDepartmentSelect, onDepartmentOpen, onDepartmentExpand, and onViewChange to connect product actions.
memberDepartmentBlock.scopeBody: The block implements the Members workspace and the expandable Departments workspace from the Figma design. The departed-member view remains an explicit integration seam rather than a placeholder screen. The surrounding application sidebar stays owned by the host shell.
